entries.zh: 议：商议定罪；共同议定判罚
entries.en: to deliberate (a sentence) in consultation; sentenced upon agreed judgment
entries.notes: 西语词头 Sentenciada alla 拼写含混，且汉栏仅录'议'一字而闽音栏有五音节，据'议'字定为商议定罪之义。

entries.zh: 批判：批判断罪（批示裁断，旧时司法用语）
entries.en: to judge, adjudicate; to pass sentence

entries.zh: 完案：结案（审断完毕，定案）
entries.en: to conclude a case; to settle it by final judgment

entries.zh: 断问：审断问罪（审问定罪）
entries.en: to examine and sentence; to interrogate and decide a case

entries.notes: 四栏（西语、汉字、闽音、官话对音）均为空，无任何材料，无从释义。

entries.en: to judge; to decide (a case); to pass judgment

entries.zh: 问毙：问成死罪（审问处死）
entries.en: to sentence to death; condemned to die (in interrogation)
entries.notes: 西语词头 en fabror 无法确解，释义据汉字'问毙'与闽音栏音写。

entries.zh: 问输：官司问输；被判败诉（判决不利于己）
entries.en: to lose one's case; judgment given against one

entries.zh: 笔头毒：判得狠毒（笔下无情，严刑峻判）
entries.en: a venomous pen; to sentence with harsh severity

entries.zh: 笔头重：判得重（下笔判罚严厉）
entries.en: a heavy pen; to pass a heavy (severe) sentence
entries.notes: 汉字与闽音可辨（笔头重＝判罚重），但第三音节声调号 T99 污损难辨，按规程降为低置信。

entries.zh: 经断：经官断罪；宣判定罪
entries.en: to adjudicate and pronounce the sentence
entries.notes: '经断'之'经'在此的用法依赖推断（经官审断或经历断案）；西语为判罪并宣判。

entries.zh: 斩首：判斩首之刑（砍头处死）
斩罪：因罪判斩（斩首或断肢之刑）
entries.en: crime punished by beheading; to sentence the cutting off of a limb for an offense

entries.zh: 断打：判打（判决杖打、鞭笞之刑）
entries.en: to sentence to a beating; flogging as punishment
entries.notes: 西语 adargazoze 疑为 a dar azotes（判予鞭笞）之误读，据汉字'断打'定为判打之义。

entries.zh: 断问：审断问罪；判词（判决）
entries.en: sentence, judgment (in court); to judge and interrogate

entries.zh: 议断：议罪断案（合议裁断）
entries.en: to deliberate and decide (a sentence); to adjudicate by consultation

entries.zh: 供状：供词状纸（审断所据的口供笔录）
entries.en: confession; written deposition (testimony on which sentence is based)

entries.zh: 议定罪：议定之罪（罪名已经议定）
entries.en: crime already determined by deliberation; one sentenced (crime settled)

entries.zh: 徒罪：徒刑之罪（判服劳役刑）
entries.en: crime punished by penal servitude; one sentenced to servitude
